notes: This config keeps the seed=42 CodeReview-New 100-example subset and the original no_review/direct/gold_location conditions.
The default model list is selected from installed Ollama tags by family. Missing required families stop the run and print pull hints without pulling models.
starcoder2:7b is intentionally excluded from the main experiment because the smoke test returned mostly empty outputs under the current Ollama chat backend.
qwen2.5-coder:3b is recorded only as an installed fallback candidate if codegemma:7b is unavailable; it is not part of the main full-run model list.
